MonitorMode.Description.Task: Each task will constantly monitor the selected store at the specified monitor delay. This will ensure you have the highest chance of picking up the product fast but uses more data and increases your chances of getting banned.
MonitorMode.Description.Shared: Only a few tasks will monitor the selected store at the specified monitor delay. The products found will then be shared across all tasks. This uses less data and allows you to set lower delays. You can configure the amount of monitoring tasks in settings.
MonitorMode.Description.Monitor: Tasks will wait for the in-bot monitor to detect a new product or restock and use the data provided by the monitor. While using this mode, no data will be used while searching for a product/restock.
AccountSelectionMode.Description.Random: Automatically assigns a random account to each task at start, ensuring diverse task distribution.
AccountSelectionMode.Description.MatchPr: Automatically assigns an account based on the task's profile email. The task will not proceed if no matching account is found.
CaptchaSource.Description.Local: Route captchas exclusively to your in-bot solvers.
CaptchaSource.Description.ThirdParty: Route captchas exclusively to third party solvers.
CaptchaSource.Description.Mobile: Route captchas exclusively to the mobile app / api.
CaptchaSource.Description.All: Route captchas to both in-bot and third party solvers. (Default)
